About This 11ty Project

This project demonstrates modern web development practices using 11ty static site generator.

Features Demonstrated:

  • ✅ Eleventy Configuration - eleventy.config.js
  • ✅ Nunjucks Templating - .njk files
  • ✅ Content Collections - Questions collection
  • ✅ Front Matter - Metadata in templates
  • ✅ Layout Reuse - layout.njk template
  • ✅ Static Assets - CSS styling
  • ✅ Build Process - npm scripts
  • ✅ Markdown Content - This page!

Technical Stack:

  • 11ty Static Site Generator
  • Nunjucks Templating Engine
  • Modern CSS
  • Node.js Build Process
